purpose: Teach: 断ら/就い/傘下/綿密/総論/凝らし/辛抱/リストアップ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究を断られても次に進め
lines.en: Ren, even if the joint research gets turned down, move on to the next one.
lines.style: Low, level mentor's command; firm but not unkind, a beat of encouragement at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。助教ポストに就いた先輩のお話を聞きます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll go hear what my senior who took up the assistant professor post has to say.
lines.style: Bright immediate 'yes', then careful, slightly formal phrasing, keen to prove he's listening.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、提携機関、つまり傘下の研究所と連携しろ
lines.en: Ren, coordinate with the partner institutions — the research labs under our umbrella.
lines.style: Deliberate instruction; slows to spell out the clarification, expecting it written down.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験計画を綿密に立てます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll draw up the experiment plan meticulously.
lines.style: Earnest quick reply; precise stress on 'meticulously', pen practically audible in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文は総論から書き始めろ
lines.en: Ren, start the paper with the general overview.
lines.style: Short, settled directive; the certainty of a man who has written a hundred reports.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データ整理に工夫を凝らします
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll put some real ingenuity into organizing the data.
lines.style: Eager agreement warming into genuine enthusiasm on 'ingenuity', pace quickening slightly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究には辛抱が大事だ
lines.en: Ren, in research, perseverance is what counts.
lines.style: Quieter, weightier delivery; slow deliberate stress on 'perseverance', letting the lesson land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。関連論文をリストアップします
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll draw up a list of the related papers.
lines.style: Crisp earnest close; quick affirmative attack, steady finish, ready to get to work.
